aggregationRules: video aggregates are the mean of scene metrics
temporal metrics replace the scene temporal contribution exactly once
failureHandling: non-finite output and invalid paired samples remain observable
invalid metric values use invalidMetricScore and fail the evaluation gate
no failure is silently converted into an empty successful metric
configuration.nonFiniteHandling: filter only for percentile ordering; paired samples increment invalid count
configuration.nonNegativeClampPolicy: ratios, correlations, and penalty metrics clamp at their documented lower bound
normalizationRules: regional values are normalized by region population
configuration.percentileInterpolation: nearest lower order statistic: floor((count - 1) * fraction)
signedSemantics: signed error is generated minus reference
positive overshoot and negative undershoot remain separate diagnostics
primary objective uses absolute/log terms and never signed cancellation

definition.explicitGammaBehavior: metadata gamma finite and > 0; metadata authoritative
definition.linearBehavior: encoded signal is already linear; metadata authoritative
definition.sRGBBehavior: inverse IEC 61966-2-1 piecewise transfer; metadata authoritative
